Item 8.01. Other Events. 
On January 24, 2023, the U.S. Department of Justice, along with a number of state Attorneys General filed an antitrust complaint against Alphabet Inc. ( Alphabet ) and Google LLC ( Google ), a wholly-owned subsidiary of Alphabet, alleging that Google s digital advertising technology products violate U.S. antitrust laws. Google believes the complaint is without merit and will defend itself vigorously.
